Introducing New International Payment Plan Options!
Benefit from Flywire's flexible payment plan options and powerful global payment network.
Education payments are expensive and can be difficult for many students and families to afford. More than ever in light of COVID-19, international students and families need flexible payment options that help make education costs more manageable.
That’s why Flywire is thrilled to expand our Payment Plan offering to now support international payment methods for students and institutions worldwide!
Why offer Flywire’s payment plans to your international students?
- 50% increase in plan enrollment - 24x7 self-service account access - 40% reduction in call volume
One of our clients really said it best: “If you don’t have an agile payment plan solution, you are going to struggle.”
To learn more, we’ve put together the following resources:
- Press Release: Flywire Offers New International Payment Plan Options <[[https://www.flywire.com/news/flywires-new-international-payment-plan-options-help-improve-tuition-affordability-during-covid-19?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> - Learn More: Payment Plans <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/education/payment-plans?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> - Blog: Learn How One Bursar Managed a Crisis and Kept Students Enrolled <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/how-one-bursar-managed-a-crisis-and-kept-students-enrolled?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
If you’re ready to future-proof your payments process, request a demo here <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/education/payments?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> and we will be in touch!
